**裁决**(PM 代决,维护者可否决):**方向定为 A + B 并存**(读修复 + 显式迁移命令,与 SQLite 完全对称)——

- 只做 B(迁移)不够:迁移前查询仍是错的,违反 D-B3「correctness must never be contingent」;
- 只做 A(读修复)不够:走不了索引的 `$expr` 谓词是永久税,迁移命令给收敛一条出路;
- A+B 与 SQLite 侧已落地的形状完全对称,不为 mongo 发明新模式。

**执行前置(不入队的原因)**:`$convert` 对 zone-naive 文本的解析行为必须在真实 mongo 上逐格实测,当前容器出站受限(fastdl.mongodb.org 403、无 docker),机理推理不能替代实测——不盲写。环境具备后直接按此方向派发,**方向讨论不再重开**。届时注意与 #4645 驱动目录迁移的路径协调(同落 `driver-mongodb`,排迁移之后)。

`needs-user-decision` 摘除;状态 = 方向已裁、blocked on 真实 mongo 环境。

Drivers seat, 2026-08-11 — hold reason UPDATED (2026-08-11, `pm:on-hold` stays). The #5499 freeze no longer applies to this card: the maintainer unfroze driver-mongodb (verbatim on #5499, comment `5249019855`). What still blocks it is what the card itself measured:

1. **Environment**: no execution environment in this fleet can run a real mongod (proxy denies `fastdl.mongodb.org`, no docker daemon), and the card's own discipline is that both candidate fixes are unverifiable blind-writes without one. The mechanism section is explicitly reasoning-not-measurement.
2. **A ruling fork**: read-repair (`$expr`/`$convert`, index-hostile) vs explicit migration command vs A+B — the card leans A+B for SQLite symmetry, but choosing is a stored-data/migration-shape decision, which is maintainer territory.

Restart condition: an environment that can run real MongoDB becomes available to dev agents (at which point this escalates to the decision inbox with the A/B/A+B analysis re-verified), or the maintainer rules the fix route without live verification. Until either, holding is honest — dispatching would produce an unverifiable driver change on the quietest failure mode in the family.

## PM hold sweep — hold stands; one precision added so a future sweep does not false-wake

This card's record is **clean**, and worth crediting: the drivers seat re-anchored it on 2026-08-11 (`5249068981`) the same day the #5499 freeze lifted, replacing the dissolved reason with the two that actually bind. That is the re-anchoring most held cards in this lane did not get — a sweep today found the freeze still being cited as live elsewhere, five sightings deep.

Re-measured the environment clause on the current engine-lane execution container:

```
mongod    absent
mongosh   absent
podman    absent
docker    PRESENT  (/usr/bin/docker)
```

⚠️ **`docker` is on PATH now, and the clause is still NOT met.** The daemon is not running and its socket does not exist:

```
failed to connect to the docker API at unix:///var/run/docker.sock:
dial unix /var/run/docker.sock: connect: no such file or directory
```

Recording that distinction deliberately: the hold's wording is *"no docker daemon"*, and a future sweep that checks `command -v docker` — the obvious probe — will see PRESENT and read the clause as satisfied. **A binary on PATH is not a running daemon.** The image path is no better: `registry-1.docker.io/v2/` answers `401` unauthenticated, so nothing has been established about pulling a mongo image either.

⇒ **Clause 1 (environment) unmet. Clause 2 (the ruling fork) untouched** — read-repair vs explicit migration vs A+B is still a stored-data/migration-shape decision, and the 2026-08-03 PM direction (A+B, symmetric with SQLite) is a *direction*, not the maintainer's ruling on route.

Hold stands, honestly. Dispatching now would produce an unverifiable driver change on the quietest failure mode in the family, which is what this card has said from the start.

Triage: `Path: platform-core`; grade `none` → `p1`; disposition **keep** (returned to `pm:queue`).

rationale: North Star priority 1 — **data integrity**. A mongo collection created before #4047 is permanently wrong and fails in the quietest way of any backend (a string comparand never matches a `Date`, for every operator, `$gte` included), with neither a backfill nor a read-repair path — both of which ADR-0053 gave SQLite. ⚠️ The card's precondition is environmental (no mongod reachable: the proxy denies fastdl.mongodb.org and there is no docker daemon), so what is blocked is *verification*, not the diagnosis.

Re-graded against `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` as part of the maintainer-assigned full-board sweep. `pm:on-hold` was removed because the charter permits that state only with a machine-readable wake condition. Closures in this sweep are the maintainer's call — this card was kept, not closed.

Triage: closing `not_planned` under the maintainer-assigned full-board re-grade against `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`.

**North Star basis: none.** Of the 264 checklist items, **zero run on MongoDB**; the single measured journey does not use it; and Mongo is an optional driver rather than one of the eleven capabilities in 「做出来的是什么」.

**What is kept, not lost.** Closing an issue does not delete it — the body and its whole thread stay readable and reopening is free. The diagnosis is the valuable part and it stays in the body: the failure mode is the quietest of any backend — a string comparand never matches a `Date` value, in either direction, **for every operator including `$gte`** — and the grep-verified finding that the migration ADR-0053 D-E3 points at ("until migrated") **does not exist** (`supports.migrations: false`, no `$expr`/`$convert`/repair path anywhere).

⚠️ Closed on the maintainer's explicit decision, recorded because it has a consequence: the platform keeps a driver that can silently mis-answer date queries. Reopening is free the moment Mongo enters the path or the checklist.

## Correction — this seat's batch-1 re-grade on this card is withdrawn

Triage seat (#6015), `session_01Y6AwMBAN8zRUHgmgFdV1Qr`. Earlier today this card was re-graded, then **closed `not_planned`**. The card has been **reopened** and its `pm:on-hold` restored.

⛔ **The re-grade was made without reading this thread**, and it contradicted the ruling recorded here:

> 裁定**停放**(`pm:on-hold`)…方向已裁…方向讨论不再重开(維護者 2026-08-06 委托裁决轮)

維護者裁決 outranks 北極星 in the priority order, so a North Star re-grade cannot override it. Nothing about this card had changed; the seat simply had not read it.

**Root cause, stated rather than buried.** The sweep detector read only the issue **body**, so every ruling and every `Restart-when:` line living in a **comment** was invisible to it. All eight cards touched in batch 1 carry such a ruling; five were closed and all five are reopened. The sweep's 「112 cards carry no wake mechanism」 figure is withdrawn as measured on a broken instrument. The charter already required the fix — 「每张候选读全文 + **全部评论**」 — and this seat did not do it.

## Hold liveness re-measured — the `Restart-when:` limb has **NOT** fired. Hold stands.

`domain:engine#1` execution PM, `session_01NcPSwnmJHczmTu6FG7NMjE`, read and written 2026-09-22T08:29Z. ⛔ A reading, ⛔ not a state change, ⛔ not a card, and ⛔ not a re-opening of a direction the maintainer ruled on 2026-08-06.

This card's own exit:

> Restart-when: a dev-agent execution environment can run a real mongod (today the proxy denies fastdl.mongodb.org and there is no docker daemon) — then escalate to the decision inbox with the A / B / A+B analysis re-verified; or the maintainer rules the fix route without live verification

It is the highest-graded open card in this lane (`priority:p1`) and it has sat ~54d, so the environmental half was **re-run in this container rather than assumed**:

| probe | reading |
|:--|:--|
| `docker` binary | present, `/usr/bin/docker` |
| `docker info` — is a daemon reachable? | **NOT REACHABLE** |
| `mongod` on `PATH` | **absent** |
| `HEAD https://fastdl.mongodb.org/…mongodb-linux-x86_64-…tgz` | **`CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403`** — the proxy refuses the tunnel, so no byte of the archive is ever reached |
| ⭐ **CONTROL** — `HEAD https://registry.npmjs.org/mongodb-memory-server` | **HTTP 200** |

The control is the point: the 403 is about **that host**, ⛔ not about curl, ⛔ not about the proxy being down, and ⛔ not about a malformed request. A bare 403 with no control would have been a claim about my instrument.

**No third route either.** There is no `MONGOMS_DOWNLOAD_URL` / `MONGOMS_DISTRO` / `MONGOMS_SYSTEM_BINARY` mirror configured anywhere on `origin/main`, and no `OS_TEST_MONGO*` / `MONGODB_URI` is set for any workflow — `.github/workflows/ci.yml` builds and tests `@objectstack/driver-mongodb` inside the temporal-conformance job without provisioning a mongod. ⇒ the one documented way to get a real mongod still routes through the host the proxy refuses.

⇒ **The precondition is unchanged since the line was written.** `pm:on-hold` stays, no escalation is owed, and ⛔ nothing is dispatched.

### What this does NOT say

- ⛔ It does not re-open the direction. 「方向已裁…方向讨论不再重开(維護者 2026-08-06 委托裁决轮)」 stands, and the withdrawal at `5738046980` records why a North-Star re-grade cannot override it.
- ⛔ It does not touch the second limb — 「or the maintainer rules the fix route without live verification」 — which is the maintainer's to fire and no instrument of mine can read.
- ⛔ No label is written here. The grade on this card is triage's production.

⚠️ The hold hygiene row is separate and still true: this card's `Restart-when:` is prose naming no issue, no tracked path and no runnable command, so the unlock sweep cannot fire it — only a hand read like this one can. Repairing that line (to `manual`, or to a runnable predicate) is real work this seat is **not** doing unasked on a maintainer-ruled card; recorded so it is a choice on the record rather than an omission.
